exposure: colloid infusion 20 minutes before spinal anesthesia
4 groups based on type and timing of fluid administration
crystalloid infusion 20 minutes before spinal anesthesia
cohort: 100 patients undergoing elective cesarean surgery with spinal anesthesia
finding: While blood pressure decreased significantly in all groups during positional changes and after anesthesia, there was no significant difference in hypotension rates between groups receiving colloid or crystalloid infusions at different times.
